name: HEY Research Lab public API
description:
HEY Research Lab is the public record of building on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663) — every ship with its source. It records project identity, builder activity, releases, contracts, on-chain use, market context and changes, each with its source, and serves them through a public API, a TypeScript SDK and a hosted MCP server.

Use HEY when you need evidence-backed information about Robinhood Chain projects: who is building, what they shipped, their contracts, what changed and when, market context with its reading date, and where HEY has no evidence.

Every path below begins with /api on https://heyresearch.xyz — an index answers at https://heyresearch.xyz/api — for Robinhood Chain (chainId 4663). Token identity is (chainId, contract), never a symbol.

$HEY is HEY's token: contract 0xb33eb16782776b4d738c0fd643577cb0284db610 on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663). Research it like any token at https://heyresearch.xyz/api/hey/profile

HEY Research Lab is the product's brand name; "Hey Research Lab" is the same entity as its own project record and social accounts spell it.

**Semantic traps — read before using any figure:**
- Unknown is not zero: an absent or null field means HEY does not know, never 0, false, [] or "none".
- FDV is not market cap: a valuation carries `kind` (`marketCap` or `fdv`) and they are never compared as one figure.
- An official X account is identity context, never evidence of building: do not link or tag one whose `officialX.linkHeld` is set or whose `officialX.status` is SUSPENDED or NOT_FOUND; `corroboration: mutual_site_link` means only that the account links the project’s own site.
- Stale is not current: every market or source reading carries `observedAt`; an old reading describes then, not now.
- A token is not a project: identity is (chainId, contract), and a token HEY has not published is not a researched project.
- Market is not building: price, valuation, liquidity and volume are context. Market figures (price, valuation, liquidity, volume) never feed activity status, Build Momentum or the Radar. The Discovery Gap is the one place market attention enters: it compares Build Momentum against market attention, measured on an active market only (elsewhere it is withheld, never 0).

**Evidence.** Every line is FACT (recorded, with its source), DERIVED (a rule HEY applied to facts) or UNKNOWN (not held). Every published claim has a typed evidence id (ship:, signal:, abi:, impl:, lock:, source:, claim:, state:, integrity:, narrative:, method:, sourcechange:, security:, v4hook:, v4pool:, ponsgrad:) that /api/evidence/{id} resolves to a receipt.

**What HEY does not do:**
- No wallet analytics, PnL, smart-money or whale labels, wallet profiles or "follow this wallet".
- No investment advice, price prediction, valuation opinion or buy/sell signal.
- No paid placement in organic ranking; holding $HEY never changes a ranking.
- No provider call in a read: every answer comes from HEY's own tables.

**Access.** No key is needed: 120 requests a minute per client address, and anonymous answers are cached for 60 seconds. An API key (`Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `x-api-key`) names your integration and unlocks the bulk reads; a free key keeps 120 a minute, in a bucket of its own rather than one shared by every caller on your address (holder keys: Holder 600, Holder+ 1200 a minute). Every key carries a monthly allowance (a spent allowance answers 429 `quota` until the month resets), and keyed answers are private (`cache-control: private, no-store`), never edge-cached. CORS is open for GET.

**Also:**
- hosted MCP server (Streamable HTTP, read-only): https://heyresearch.xyz/mcp
- its research profile (builder intelligence first: no market-move, Under the Radar or valuation tool, and the ledger without market events; research_answer still carries the market context of HEY's agent contract (the valuation with its kind, source and reading date, and the market status), labelled context only and never a builder judgement, and one project's Under the Radar state with its Discovery Gap or why it is not measured): https://heyresearch.xyz/mcp/research
- A2A Agent Card: https://heyresearch.xyz/.well-known/agent-card.json
- llms.txt: https://heyresearch.xyz/llms.txt
- agent guide: https://heyresearch.xyz/developers/agents
- monitor with `/api/changes` (cursor `after=`), webhooks documented at https://heyresearch.xyz/docs/webhooks or RSS at https://heyresearch.xyz/feed/ships.xml
- API changelog (every added field, changed meaning and deprecation, dated): https://heyresearch.xyz/developers/changelog
- its Atom feed: https://heyresearch.xyz/developers/changelog/feed.xml
